summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of the action-based logging refactor (Settings ActionsEditor, HomeSearch, RecentlyUsedRow, CompactActivityCard, AppContext.logActivity, LogModal). All 9 scenarios from the review request pass cleanly with zero console errors. localStorage entries correctly persist with both actionId and category fields.
scenarios_verified: Settings (/settings) renders [data-testid=actions-editor] with Positive (6 rows) and Negative (4 rows) lists by default — matches DEFAULT_ACTIONS seed.
Add Action: clicked add-action-toggle, filled name 'TEST Sprint Action', category 'PT Study', type Positive, minutes 0, points 5 → saved → appeared under positive-actions-list with '+5 pts' label.
Edit Action: changed Type Positive→Negative → row moved to negative-actions-list and points sign auto-corrected to '-5 pts' (text observed: 'TEST Sprint Action — PT Study · -5 pts').
Delete Action: window.confirm auto-accepted, action-row-<id> removed from DOM.
Home instant log: log-btn-act-published clicked → toast 'Published Post/Reel logged +25 pts Undo' fired.
Home timed log: log-btn-act-pt-study clicked → [data-testid=log-modal] visible → log-modal-preset-30 clicked → toast '30m PT Study logged +10 pts Undo' fired.

HomeSearch: typed 'pt' in home-search-input → search-results visible with 'Actions' heading and 1 result (search-result-action-act-pt-study). search-log-action-act-pt-study (timed) opened LogModal correctly.
RecentlyUsedRow: after logging instant action, chip [data-testid=recent-chip-act-published] visible on Home.

Persistence: /log page shows entry '+30 min PT Study' with category 'PT STUDY' and points '+10' after refresh. localStorage cbe.entries.v1 entry contains keys: id,date,time,category,actionId,actionName,minutes,points,type,icon — actionId and category both populated.
critical_code_review_comments: AppContext.jsx addAction overrides any incoming id with generateId(). ActionsEditor.handleAdd already creates an id via `act-<ts>-<rnd>` and spreads it into the payload — that id is silently discarded. Not a bug today (the spread order means the generated id wins), but worth noting: if you ever need stable client-provided ids, addAction would clobber them. Recommend `addAction({ ...action, id: action.id || generateId() })` to be defensive.

Settings.jsx line 258 has odd inline formatting: `function AllocationTargetsEditor({ actions, targets, onChange }) {  const positiveCategories = ...` — opening brace and statement on same line; harmless but lints unevenly.

AllocationTargetsEditor derives positive categories via `actions.filter(a => a.type === 'positive')`. After the refactor, positivity is also encoded on the category (cat.type). If a user keeps an action's type as 'positive' but moves it to a negative category (or vice-versa), allocation rows may misrepresent intent. Worth deciding which is source of truth (the code in ActionsEditor.renderRow already treats action.type as source of truth — consistent).
Default seed actions all share the same DEFAULT_ACTIONS ids (act-pt-study, act-published, ...). If a user manually adds an action with that exact id (unlikely), there's no de-dup check in addAction.
HomeSearch + RecentlyUsedRow + CompactActivityCard all duplicate ~10 lines of quickLog/logActivity logic. Candidate for an `useActionLogger()` hook to DRY up.
test_credentials: n/a — pure client-side PWA, no auth
seed_data_creation: Tests rely on the auto-seeded DEFAULT_ACTIONS (6 positive + 4 negative) that storage.js writes on first load. Tests cleared localStorage at start of run to ensure a clean baseline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All testids referenced in the review request exist and behave as documented. The timed action card on Home (log-btn-act-pt-study) is rendered but may be below the fold on mobile viewport — scroll_into_view_if_needed is required before clicking. Console-error listener stayed clean across all flows. localStorage keys: cbe.actions.v1, cbe.entries.v1, cbe.settings.v1.
